method: DVII extract_statement_lines over each unit of cases/statement-units (fc93c39d), on a cell-marked re-conversion of the filing (td/th boundaries joined by ' | '); line-aligned with convert_html's text (asserted). A row's label is its own label cell (review H1: each <tr> is one line, so DVII's continuation merge would glue a heading row on). Headers are not part of the key (review L1). BGS excluded (CP1H-R18 F1).
